effect.name: Flovart Scene Replace
effect.targetSdk: After Effects C++ Effect SDK (version pinned at real-host gate)
effect.description: Bilinearly resamples and blends an imported footage layer over the current frame. CEP source writes a content-addressed candidate and a version manifest in the layer comment; project portability is unverified. Source code is not compiled or host-certified.

fields: After Effects interpreted width, height, duration, frame rates, frame duration, and pixel aspect ratio
After Effects interpreted alpha presence, mode, inversion, and premultiplication color when available
project color working space, gamma, bit depth, and linearization settings
sourceCompId and sourceLayerId when imported against a selection
limitations: manifest is provenance metadata and is not checked by the native render callback
the native render path reads 8-bit pixels; the CEP application action refuses projects whose bit depth is not 8
output extent and origin handling are not implemented or declared
CEP verifies the staged file's byte size and SHA-256 before renaming it to the content-addressed path, then rechecks the candidate before apply
the native render callback does not detect external changes made after apply
relocation/relinking and project collection are not implemented
captured media values describe After Effects' imported interpretation; embedded source color profile and authoritative frame count are not recorded
project collection and cross-machine portability are unverified
CEP full-file readback cost and host compatibility, especially for large video files, are unverified

parameters.name: Asset Version
parameters.role: The selected After Effects footage layer is the applied media version. The AEP stores the layer reference; current media bytes remain in CEP USER_DATA.

parameters.name: Blend
parameters.role: Mix intensity: 0 shows the original frame, 100 shows the selected media version.

dataflow: check out the selected footage layer from After Effects at the current frame
blend the checked-out frame with the effect input by Blend percent
check the layer back in before returning
if checkout fails or no layer pixels are available, report a render error rather than outputting a successful pass-through
nonGoals: no filesystem path parsing or image/video decoder in the render callback
no network access, generation calls, or Agent/browser/service dependency in the render callback
no transform/mask/tracking editor — host-native controls cover those
no generic Host SDK abstraction — this file targets the AE Effect SDK directly
externalGate: compile with the real AE Effect SDK and Windows toolchain; reconcile SDK version and PiPL flags
apply a candidate through CEP and verify the exact source layer id is bound
test 8-bit blend output against an independent reference, including alpha, row padding, cropped extent, masks, and upstream origin changes
save, close, and reopen a project and verify the footage reference and Blend keyframes
apply V1 then V2, undo and redo, and confirm V1 media remains available
export with the Flovart service and network stopped
test missing footage and unsupported bit depth error visibility
verify After Effects to Premiere effect compatibility separately
enable output extent only after clipped extent and origin handling passes
enable Multi-Frame Rendering only after thread-safety analysis and real-host stress testing
